references.purpose: exact character and game pixel-art style reference

normalization.notes: Largest 8-connected alpha component selected per figure, then fit with Lanczos to a 62x80 maximum inside 80x96 cells, centered with 9px horizontal margins and baseline y93. Detached components under 1000 source pixels are excluded. No anatomical pixels are painted or invented.

cleanupAttempts.method: 8-connected component isolation and Lanczos fit to 62x80
cleanupAttempts.review: rejected by independent visual review for soft/muddy downsampling and visible fringe specks

cleanupAttempts.method: nearest-neighbor fit to 62x80 with binary alpha silhouette
cleanupAttempts.review: rejected pending cleanup by independent review; target-scale crispness improved but red/cyan fringe pixels remained

cleanupAttempts.method: nearest-neighbor and binary alpha followed by removal of four specifically reviewed red/cyan fringe pixels
cleanupAttempts.review: source candidate accepted by independent visual review on 2026-10-27; native Jam Stage integration review pending

review.reviewNotes: Four pose silhouettes, anatomy, identity, 80x96 readability, baseline, margins, ball-free art, and cleaned edge pixels passed independent source review. Slight soft interior shading at 4x was considered acceptable. Native Jam Stage candidate integration remains pending.
